soundness_flags.label: ass:fixed-covariance-rank
soundness_flags.one_line: Uniform fixed conditional rank and a positive spectral gap for both covariance fields are load-bearing for inference, but the Gaussian witness and unspecified local neighborhoods do not establish that this nonstandard condition is realistically applicable beyond an instrumental regularity device.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Open-ended Question 1 and Theorems 4–5
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Full observed-data canonical-gradient efficiency is not yet established; the one-step and band claims are conditional on an affirmative tangent-space-factorization result.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The contribution is the observable quotient and linear-span frontier unconditionally, with semiparametric efficiency and attaining inference only conditional on resolution of Open-ended Question 1.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the fixed-rank spectral-gap condition with a regularized or rank-adaptive projection theorem, or give a substantive rotating-panel design class under which conditional rank and the gap are verifiably uniform.
State a directly checkable sufficient condition for the tangent-space factorization on a nontrivial pattern family before attempting the fully arbitrary-pattern OEQ.
Add one worked non-Gaussian rotating-panel example showing how the quotient, covariance loading, and gain are computed from observable primitives.

recommended_next_step: Revise the inference regime to justify or weaken the fixed-rank condition, while retaining the accepted conditional scope for full semiparametric efficiency; then advance the observable quotient kernel to Stage 0.
